title: QUALITY-FRESHNESS — Content freshness decay: auto-archive stale queue items
summary: Added added_at ISO timestamp to QueueItem interface. New archiveStaleItems() function archives pending items older than STALE_DAYS (7) by setting status=skipped. Wired into main() before pending check so stale items are cleaned before replenish decides whether to generate. New items stamped with added_at on write.
